# What did that DNS change actually do?

> Capture what public resolvers answer for a customer domain, capture again after the change, and get a source-linked report of what changed, what did not, and what could not be observed. Free, runs entirely in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
